sources.title: Efficient Reasoning Exploration via State-Conditioned Latent Steering ...
sources.snippet: During online inference, SPS retrieves a suitable steering vector based on the current prefix state and applies it at high-uncertainty transitions to guide the next reasoning step toward meaningful progress. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and benchmarks demonstrate that SPS consistently outperforms strong baselines.
